ai_review.summary: Decent‑sounding tape that finally captures the rare Stagger Lee performance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds this recording clearer than their old boombox playback, indicating a respectable level of fidelity for an archival source. The highlight noted is the inclusion of “Stagger Lee,” a song fans were eager to hear from this tour. Overall the sentiment is appreciative and positive despite limited detail on technical aspects.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; reviewer praises both the sound quality (better than a boombox) and the rare Stagger Lee performance, leading to an overall positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound clearer than typical boombox playback; no specific issues or drop‑outs mentioned.
